q1_issues.issue: "The Keepers" is a definite capitalized PLURAL kind-word label, which the instruction set routes to a Name-only individual (one symbol plus a mandatory Name atom, explicitly no GroupOf and no per-member kind taken from the label word); the parse instead emits (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) and no Name atom, i.e. exactly the atom that clause bars plus the omission of the one it requires.

notes: Everything else is well-grounded: "time X to Y" takes the prepositional-verb oblique (To) rather than a spatial Goal, the scheduled-occurrence object correctly takes Patient, both compounds get head genus only (noun modifiers unexposed), and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom.
